name: Detroit Edible | 200mg Crispy Treats | Cinnamon Toast
description: Detroit Edibles has taken Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal and transformed it into a delicious crispy and gooey marshmallow treat. If you’re a fan of cinnamon and sugar, this is the edible for you. Each crispy contains a potent 200mg of THC and will marsh-MELLOW you out with every bite. Fully activates in 1-2 hours.
